# netbox_cable (Resource)

Manages a NetBox cable (`/api/dcim/cables/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_manufacturer" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
resource "netbox_device_type" "example" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.example.id
  model           = "example"
  slug            = "example"
}
resource "netbox_device_role" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
resource "netbox_site" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
resource "netbox_device" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.example.id
  role_id        = netbox_device_role.example.id
  site_id        = netbox_site.example.id
}
resource "netbox_interface" "a" {
  device_id = netbox_device.example.id
  name      = "eth0"
  type      = "1000base-t"
}
resource "netbox_interface" "b" {
  device_id = netbox_device.example.id
  name      = "eth1"
  type      = "1000base-t"
}
resource "netbox_cable" "example" {
  a_terminations = [{ object_type = "dcim.interface", object_id = netbox_interface.a.id }]
  b_terminations = [{ object_type = "dcim.interface", object_id = netbox_interface.b.id }]
  type           = "cat6"
  label          = "example"
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `a_terminations` (Attributes List) A Terminations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--a_terminations))
- `b_terminations` (Attributes List) B Terminations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--b_terminations))
- `bundle_id` (Number) ID of the Cable Bundle (`netbox_cable_bundle`).
- `color` (String) Color. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `label` (String) Label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `length` (Number) Length.
- `length_unit` (String) Length Unit. Valid values: `km`, `m`, `cm`, `mi`, `ft`, `in`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `profile` (String) Profile. Valid values: `single-1c1p`, `single-1c2p`, `single-1c4p`, `single-1c6p`, `single-1c8p`, `single-1c12p`, `single-1c16p`, `trunk-2c1p`, `trunk-2c2p`, `trunk-2c4p`, `trunk-2c4p-shuffle`, `trunk-2c6p`, `trunk-2c8p`, `trunk-2c12p`, `trunk-4c1p`, `trunk-4c2p`, `trunk-4c4p`, `trunk-4c4p-shuffle`, `trunk-4c6p`, `trunk-4c8p`, `trunk-8c4p`, `breakout-1c2p-2c1p`, `breakout-1c4p-4c1p`, `breakout-1c6p-6c1p`, `breakout-1c8p-8c1p`, `breakout-2c4p-8c1p-shuffle`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `connected`, `planned`, `decommissioning`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `type` (String) Type. Valid values: `cat3`, `cat5`, `cat5e`, `cat6`, `cat6a`, `cat7`, `cat7a`, `cat8`, `mrj21-trunk`, `dac-active`, `dac-passive`, `coaxial`, `rg-6`, `rg-8`, `rg-11`, `rg-59`, `rg-62`, `rg-213`, `lmr-100`, `lmr-200`, `lmr-400`, `mmf`, `mmf-om1`, `mmf-om2`, `mmf-om3`, `mmf-om4`, `mmf-om5`, `smf`, `smf-os1`, `smf-os2`, `aoc`, `power`, `usb`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_cable can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_cable.example 123
```
